name: Veyra-NRVideo
description: Bring PS5 GTA6 to 120FPS with DLSS 5. An advanced Windows video player and capture enhancement tool featuring real-time preview for videos, images, and capture card sources. Combine AI-powered Super Resolution, DLSS5 image enhancement, and Frame Generation to deliver a next-generation visual experience.
one_liner: A Windows app that makes gameplay footage, old videos, or a capture card feed look sharper and smoother in real time, using the same kind of AI upscaling found in modern graphics cards.
buyer: A Twitch or YouTube gaming creator who wants captured console footage or old recordings to look like a modern, high-FPS, upscaled video without new hardware or hours of editing.
business_use_cases: A streamer runs captured console footage through it live to deliver smoother, sharper streams to viewers without buying new hardware.
A YouTuber restores and upscales old low-resolution gameplay recordings for a 'remastered' retrospective video series.
A small video-production shop offers a paid 'footage enhancement' service to clients with old low-quality video who want it to look modern.

money_ideas.idea: A freemium app: free basic enhancement, paid tier for frame generation, HDR, and higher output resolutions
A one-off 'enhance my footage' service for clients with old, low-resolution video

steal_this: Offer a $20-per-video 'make your old gameplay footage look next-gen' service on Fiverr this weekend using it.
